description.value: Wayward Distillery is a craft spirits producer operating in Courtenay in the Comox Valley since 2014, still run by its original three founders. The distillery is best known for fermenting most of its lineup — vodkas, gins, rum, and liqueurs — from sustainable BC honey, and donates 1% of all spirit sales to Pollinator Partnership Canada. Cyclists can visit the distillery store directly or browse an award-winning range of spirits, with the business also holding Rainbow Registered and Living Wage Employer status.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (2931 Moray Avenue, Courtenay, BC) and phone (250-871-0424) exactly. The site confirms this is a publicly visitable craft distillery with a retail store, open seven days a week. A name discrepancy exists: OSM lists 'Wayward Distillation House' while the website consistently uses 'Wayward Distillery'. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Wayward Distillation House' but every page of the website consistently uses 'Wayward Distillery'. The OSM name may be outdated or incorrect and could benefit from a tag correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible craft distillery and retail store in Courtenay, open seven days a week; a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Comox Valley.

Packed lunches.detail: Distillery sells spirits only; no food items listed in the shop inventory
